_note: RU is the contract language — these strings mirror the .od/index.html mockup verbatim. This file is the localization seam (the i18n analogue of useMockData.ts): every visible string has a key here, components read it via t(). When the mockup changes a string, change it here and mark the section drifted in PARITY.json. Key convention: [area].[element], areas mirror nav section ids.
